market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $50,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC ~7k on May 1, 2026; needs ~35% drop to print 0k by Dec 31, 2026. Feb 2026 saw ~50% drawdown from 26k peak (~3k low), so volatility is high. With 8 months left a 0k touch is plausible though far from base case.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Macro shocks, stablecoin/regulatory events, miner capitulation.
